title: PlaybackState::pending_media_seek is an Option tuple with a bare ChatId and no account owner
trigger: Open a t.me/c/..?t=30 link, then switch account before the message loads, to an account that also shows the same chat id
effect: the seek can fire (or be dropped) for the other account's same-id chat; self-expires after 12 s
fix: hold it in the owning OnScreen/ChatUi as an enum MediaSeek::Waiting{chat: AccountChat, message, seconds, deadline}

title: FolderLoad::Merging is a bare in-flight stage; its answer is matched by purpose+folder id and the fetch is re-sent from upkeep
trigger: Edit a folder, change it elsewhere, press Save: start_folder_editor_merge sends fetch_chat_folder, drops the RequestId and enters Merging; settle_folder_editor_merge (run from maybe_prefill_folder_editor on every poll) matches with requests.has_purpose_for_folder(GetChatFolder, id) and re-sends fetch_chat_folder when no request and no error is left
effect: another window's/older GetChatFolder for the same folder counts as ours; a swept request is re-sent each poll; with no live session Merging has no way out except cancel
fix: Merging { request: RequestId } settled with fetch.waits_for/answered like Loading and Saving
